description: The National Statistics Office of Georgia publishes the results of the 2024 Population and Agricultural Census as downloadable tables, with a living conditions folder of 13 workbooks on dwellings and their occupants. Table 13 counts dwellings, occupants and private households, separately for individual houses and separate apartments, by the facilities present: electricity, piped gas, a heating system, individual means of heating, water supply, a flush toilet, sewage, a bath or shower and a hot water system. Coverage is Georgia, Tbilisi, Adjara and nine regions, each for all, urban and rural settlements, and excludes the occupied territories. As of 14 November 2024 there were 1,190,110 such dwellings; 1,169,007 had electricity, 1,062,779 piped gas, 472,040 a heating system, 1,079,084 water supply and 964,543 sewage. Other tables give dwellings by type of housing, rooms, floor space, persons, households per dwelling and tenure. Format and access: free XLSX downloads, with a site converter to CSV, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: region level only in these tables; the census microsite showed no content without JavaScript. Simulation uses: regional gas, heating, water and sewage coverage for network planning and household energy demand models, and dwelling stock for exposure. Related records: the Cyprus census 2021 conventional dwellings tables.
